<<<image_1>>> (Jax — main character) — Young Black male in his 20s, 182cm tall, lean athletic build, super short bleached buzz cut, dark skin, sharp features, focused intense gaze, iris with subtle yellow-amber tint. Black wraparound tactical safety glasses worn ON his eyes (single curved clear lens, black temples — Oakley-style sport tactical eyewear). Black tight tactical compression T-shirt, olive/khaki tactical cargo pants (belt + side pockets), black fingerless tactical gloves, black military combat boots (high-top).

<<<image_2>>> (Training arena) — Massive concrete octagonal training hall, octagonal walls + triangular faceted dome ceiling, Ø52m. Central area = octagonal training platform Ø45m (raised ~10cm step above outer floor). <<<image_3>>> (Metal Table) is positioned EXACTLY at the geometric CENTER of the octagonal training platform. Outer floor = darker weathered concrete with dormant mechanical arms along walls + distant entrance door on back wall. Walls = dark charcoal-gray concrete with warm amber practical wall lamps.

<<<image_3>>> (Metal Table) — Heavy industrial brutalist welded-steel test table, 3-slab inverted-U (top + 2 end-wall slabs, NOT 4 legs). Dimensions: ~180cm × ~90cm × 70cm tall. Top slab and end-wall slabs are 5cm-thick solid stainless steel plates. Underside between end-walls is open (no front/back — see-through sideways). Visible weld seams along corners. Brushed weathered stainless, gray-silver with mottled darker oxidation patches, grime, smudges, scratches, dents, aged patina. Looks like polished concrete cast in steel.

STYLE: 8K IMAX cinematic, multi-shot edit. Hyper-realistic — NO 3D rendering, NO game engine, NO game-CG cutscene look. Cinematography: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins.
LIGHTING: STRICTLY only practicals existing in the scene. NO cinematic fill of any kind — no front fill, no side fill, no toplight, no underlight, no bounce boards, no softboxes, no LED strips, no neon, no off-camera light sources whatsoever. Camera is always on the subject's shadow side — face is naturally lit but framed from the darker side; practicals provide rim and eye-light. Atmospheric haze throughout for aerial depth — NO visible light shafts (no god rays).
COLOR: 60:30:10 — cool blue / concrete gray / red accent.
LENS: physical cinema glass. 180° shutter motion blur.
SKIN: pore-level realism — peach fuzz, asymmetric moles, capillary flush, pore shadows matching on-set lighting.
PERFORMANCE: Hollywood grade — micro-pauses before reactions, precise eyelines, wet living eyes with catchlights, visible breathing and chest rise/fall.
PHYSICS: real gravity and inertia — mass carries real weight, correct contact shadows. NO floating props.
COMPOSITION: rule of thirds + golden ratio. Every person is moving from frame one. Avoid central compositions.
CONTINUITY: characters, props and environment fully consistent across every shot. No identity drift.
SCENE/ENVIRONMENT: strictly replicate the architecture, materials, lighting and spatial layout of the <<<image_2>>> reference — do NOT drift from the reference into a different style of interior.
TECHNICAL: 60fps smooth motion. 8K detail. No jitter.
AUDIO: ambient SFX only. NO music. NO subtitles.

JAX CHARACTER — Slightly dumb himbo + jokester + cocky bro Black male. Sometimes uses AAVE slang. All emotions slightly comedic — overreacts, dumb-funny takes, himbo energy, NOT serious-dramatic. Expression tendencies: exaggerated but not cartoonish, often a smirk / cocky half-smile, dumb-founded blank stare when confused, cocky + self-pleased when satisfied, himbo-style complaining when frustrated. He's a goofy bro with laughs, not a serious hero.

SCENE: Training 3 — Situation 4 · 6 of 4cm (ping-pong sized) BLACK clay bombs · vertical upward throws to 30-40m + 40-50m apex · "I FUCKIN HATE CLOWNS!!!!" + "Iced coffee!!" + "I fuckin hate---TRAININGS!!!!".

═══ COMPASS (Scene 3 final):
  NORTH=back wall+door, SOUTH=opposite wall, EAST/WEST=sides.
  Jax: ON the table at platform CENTER, facing UP toward dome ceiling.
  Camera: orbits around Jax in 3/4.
═══

SCENE STAGING — Jax stands ON <<<image_3>>> at platform CENTER (head height = 252cm above floor). Jax ALONE.

【SHOT 1】 — [Jax on table; cam orbits] WS establishing Jax climbs onto <<<image_3>>> in 3/4 angle on Jax (side/behind-side, never frontal), rule-of-thirds framing, 12mm wide, shaky handheld camera motion + tracks Jax climbing up.  Jax <<<image_1>>> walks to the table with all 6 4cm BLACK clay bombs in his left palm, climbs up (clumsy himbo climb), straightens centered on top, right hand free. Cocky himbo posture.

【SHOT 2】 — [Jax on table; cam orbits] MS Jax <<<image_1>>> + WS up-track + apex explosion → CU Jax face descend in 3/4 angle on Jax (side/behind-side, never frontal), rule-of-thirds framing, 35mm → 12mm wide → 85mm, shaky handheld camera motion + tracks Jax's right-hand uppercut throw + whip-pan UP tracking the ball + camera snap-jolt at apex explosion + camera physically descends back DOWN to Jax's face. Jax takes one ball into his right, uppercut-style straight up vertical throw (~25-28m/s), ball flies up ~5-6s to ~30-40m apex. Jax tilts head up watching the ball + yells: JAX (loud raw shout looking up): "I FUCKIN HATE CLOWNS!!!!" At "CLOWNS" the ball at ~30-40m apex detonates. Camera physically descends from sky-tracking back DOWN to Jax's face: charging-up optimism — eyes glinting, smile growing.

【SHOT 3】 — [Jax on table; cam orbits] MS Jax <<<image_1>>> + WS up-track + apex explosion → Jax happy in 3/4 angle on Jax (side/behind-side, never frontal), rule-of-thirds framing, 35mm → 12mm wide, shaky handheld camera motion + tracks Jax's second uppercut throw + whip-pan UP. Jax takes second black 4cm ball, uppercut-style straight up throw (~25-28m/s, ~30-40m apex), tilts head up + yells: JAX (loud shout, in English): "Iced coffee!!" At "coffee" the second ball detonates at ~30-40m apex. Jax: real growing joy + accumulating delight, almost laughing.

【SHOT 4】 — [Jax on table; cam orbits] MS Jax crouch + WS up-track + 4-bomb sync explosion in 3/4 angle on Jax (side/behind-side, never frontal), rule-of-thirds framing, 35mm → 12mm wide, shaky handheld camera motion + tracks Jax's bigger windup + double-handed throw + whip-pan UP + multi-jolt as 4 explosions sync. Jax bends down low (knees bend deep for bigger windup), starts through clenched teeth: JAX (low setup voice): "I fuckin hate---" Then uncoils explosively — both hands throw the remaining 4 black 4cm balls STRAIGHT UP (~30-32m/s, ~6-7s flight to 40-50m apex), arms thrust upward. As the balls leave his hands and arms shoot up, Jax tilts head up and yells the rest (in English): JAX (loud raw shout, arms up, in English): "---TRAININGS!!!!" At the moment he yells "TRAININGS" all 4 balls at ~40-50m apex detonate IMMEDIATELY simultaneously (4 fireballs synchronously bloom at ~40-50m height, shockwaves descend toward Jax).

【SHOT 5】 — [Jax on table; cam orbits] slow-mo orbital CU portrait + high-G face deformation, 85mm F2.0, slow-mo ~1000fps + camera orbits Jax's side/three-quarter view (on top of <<<image_3>>>). Jax's head tilts up looking at sky + both arms raised + 4 explosion fireballs above/behind him. Shockwave hits face VERTICALLY FROM ABOVE since Jax looks up. 3-PHASE HIGH-G FACE DEFORMATION (positive G's, all soft tissue pulled DOWNWARD): [P1 0-50ms] head up, buzz cut flat, forehead skin stretched DOWN, brows down, eyelids droop. [P2 50-200ms PEAK] cheeks pulled DOWN like melting wax, lower eyelids DOWN exposing white sclera, mouth corners DOWN into inverted-U sad-mask, lower lip DOWN exposing teeth, mouth in inverted-trapezoid, chin forming triple chin, heavy jowls — G-LOC face — entire face stretched DOWN. Sweat drops fly DOWN. [P3 200-500ms recovery] skin bounces back, jowls dissolve, Jax opens eyes, recovers to relaxed joyful smile. SFX only, no music, no subtitles.

Operator orbits from Jax's <<<image_1>>> side-back around to his front to a multi-layered composition of his hands+face+throat. Jax tightens his cheekbones+jaw, throat visibly strains+bulges, vomits a shapeless dark-gray clay-textured mass into his right palm, then both hands work it — rotating, squeezing, smoothing — to form it into a 5cm (ping-pong sized) darker-gray clay ball, then he raises his head and looks toward the water area, jaw set in concentration.
